newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, market edgy as payrolls loom.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, market edgy as payrolls loom.

text.p: London's FTSE 100 index crept higher into record territory at the start of trade on Friday but share prices were mixed and dealers said nerves ahead of key U.S. payrolls figures would prevent the market charging upwards.
By 0835 GMT, the FTSE was 4.8 points higher at a new peak of 4,404.1, edging ahead despite Wall Street's retreat from its early gains.
But declining stocks outnumbered gainers in the FTSE and dealers said the market's advanced was led by just a handful of shares, with Glaxo Wellcome Plc , BTR Plc and GKN Plc in the vanguard.
